title: VANDIRA Official Election Data Connectors
policy: Primary-source retrieval first. Existing canonical election/booth JSON remains read-only and is not rewritten by connectors.

connectors.note: Connector discovers the current ECI 2022 UP election resources rather than hard-coding transient backend download URLs.

connectors.authority: Government of Uttar Pradesh — Information & Public Relations Department
Government of Uttar Pradesh — Information & Public Relations Department

conflict_policy: For official facts and election statistics, prefer the latest relevant primary source and expose conflicts instead of silently merging them.
freshness_policy: Official live retrieval is supplemental to the immutable local dataset; every live item carries retrieved_at and source_url.
coverage_note: STEP86 starts the official connector layer. It does not claim that every public ECI/CEO/Assembly document has already been ingested. The connector discovers and surfaces official resources for subsequent ingestion.
